about_the_game:
Enter a magical world where you play as a familiar cat helping a witch. Explore a whimsical fantasy world filled with curious townsfolk, hidden secrets, and mysterious creatures. What begins as a lighthearted journey to help your witch companion with daily errands quickly grows into something far more sinister. A shadow looms over the village, and it’s up to you to uncover the truth and protect those you care about. Unlock magical abilities as you complete quests.
.Transform into a bird to soar over obstacles and reach new heights

.Dive in as a fish to collect hidden treasures beneath the waves

.Grow in size to take on bigger threats and solve environmental puzzles

.Wield projectile spells to fend off creatures and knock over objects

With light combat, platforming challenges, and an open world that evolves with the story, Meow Familiar World invites you into a playful yet mysterious adventure—purrfect for cat lovers, cozy game fans, and anyone seeking a magical escape.

Key Features

* Play as a customizable magical cat

* Explore a open world with evolving areas

* Use shapeshifting and spellcasting to solve challenges

* Full controller support

* Meet quirky villagers, uncover secrets, and confront a growing darkness

short_description: Open World third-person adventure and exploration game. Play as a cat familiar and gain magical abilities as you help save the fishing villagers. Solve puzzles, transform into different animals, defeat your foes, compile quests in your journal, and just be a cat and relax sometimes.
